sec-oncall: Security advisory - org-wide action required: KMS key policy change incoming from cloud provider that will enforce new key-wrapping algorithm (KMSv2) on 2026-04-02 00:00 UTC. Any data encrypted with our existing customer-managed keys must be rewrapped before the cutoff or services will fail to decrypt.
sec-oncall: Impact: potential outages for services that rely on older wrapped keys (DEKs) — databases, secrets stores, object encryption. This is proactive but urgent: rewrap or rotate DEKs and test decryption flows.
kms-admin: confirmed. Cloud provider sent notice: https://provider.status/internal/notice-kmsv2 (internal mirror). They will start rejecting legacyWrap operations after cutoff.
alice: ack. Which key aliases are in scope? I maintain several KMS keys for vault, s3, and db encryption.
kms-admin: scope = all customer-managed keys under projects: redwood-prod, redwood-staging, redwood-ops. Use `kmsctl list-keys --owner redwood` to enumerate. Particularly check aliases: alias/vault-main, alias/s3-obj-enc, alias/db-encrypt.
bob: starting inventory: `kmsctl list-keys --owner redwood --out /tmp/kms-keys.txt` then `jq -r '.keys[] | select(.type=="CMK") .alias' /tmp/kms-keys.txt`. Will share list in 15m.
infra: temporary mitigation: enabling provider-managed wrapping fallback for non-critical services where possible, but this is not a long-term fix. Owners must rewrap.
sre: plan to schedule rolling rewrap job for DBs during low-traffic windows. Need checklists for safe rewrap with freeze windows.
ops-bot: automated scan: found 12 secrets engines using alias/vault-main that have DEKs older than 2025-06-01 and likely need rewrap: (vault-kv, ci-secrets, analytics-secrets). See /reports/kms-2026-03-26.
kms-admin: recommended command pattern: 1) export DEK metadata: `kmsctl get-dek-metadata --key alias/<key> --out meta.json` 2) rewrap: `kmsctl rewrap --key alias/<key> --input-dek <dek> --algorithm KMSv2-AESKW --out <new-dek>` 3) rotate envelope keys: `vault transit rewrap --key <transit-key> --new-wrapping-key <new-dek>` 4) validate decryption in staging.
alice: I'll prioritize alias/vault-main and alias/s3-obj-enc. For Vault: plan is to create test token, rewrap 1 mount at a time, and run `vault read` checks. PR for schedule: infra/security#560.
sec-oncall: required owner checklist: - Enumerate resources using the CMK - Rewrap all DEKs to KMSv2 before 2026-04-02T00:00Z - Update Vault and config to reference new envelope keys - Run decryption smoke tests and rollbacks - Report completion in this thread with evidence (command output or report link)
bob: started rewrap job for alias/s3-obj-enc in staging: `kmsctl rewrap --key alias/s3-obj-enc --input-bucket-manifests s3-staging://manifests/ --batch` job queued.
infra: warning: some older SDKs don't support KMSv2 envelopes. If you see SDK errors during rewrap, update SDK to latest minor and re-run.
sre: scheduling DB rewrap for users-db on 2026-03-29 03:00-04:30 UTC (low-traffic). We'll snapshot before rewrap and have quick rollback plan.
legal: please ensure we preserve audit trail and provider notices for compliance. If any customer data access is impacted, notify security and legal immediately.
ops-bot: automated check result: SDK compatibility scan shows 7 services using legacy-kms-client v1.x. Owners: alice, carol, dan need to upgrade clients.
alice: upgrading vault-transit helper to v2.1. Patching staging now.
sec-oncall: mitigation notes: - For services that cannot rewrap before cutoff, we can temporarily enable provider wrap-compat toggles (if supported) but plan to rewrap asap. - Do not delete old DEKs until after verification.
bob: rewrap staged for s3 in staging completed, smoke tests green: `s3-decrypt-test --key alias/s3-obj-enc --file test-object` returned success.
alice: vault rewrap in staging completed for kv mounts 1 and 2. Running full integration test suite now.
infra: adding CI gating: new pre-deploy check `kms-compat-check` that fails if service references legacy CMKs.
sre: if any team cannot complete rewrap by cutoff, open an exception ticket with reason and mitigation steps. We will maintain exception list centrally.
sec-oncall: please report completion by posting: key alias, resource list, timestamp, and smoke-test output link. Example: `alias/vault-main - vault-kv, ci-secrets - 2026-03-28T18:45Z - /reports/vault-rewrap-28032026`.
alice: posted completion for alias/vault-main: rewrap done 2026-03-28T18:42Z, smoke tests green: /reports/vault-rewrap-28032026
bob: posting completion for alias/s3-obj-enc: 2026-03-28T19:10Z, tests passed.
sec-oncall: closing note: cutoff is 2026-04-02T00:00Z. Owners who haven't reported by 2026-03-30 23:59Z will get a follow-up. If you need help, tag @kms-admin or @sec-oncall. :lock:
